title.zh: 将第1613号共和国法项下用于朗布隆Cajidiocan Ayahag建造一间教室的预制校舍的2600比索拨款转给同市镇Cantagda的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring the Appropriation of Two Thousand Six Hundred Pesos for the Construction of a One-Room Prefabricated School Building in Ayahag, Cajidiocan, Romblon, Under Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred and Thirteen, to Cantagda of the Same Municipality
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Appropriation of Two Thousand Six Hundred Pesos for the Construction of a One-Room Prefabricated School Building in Ayahag, Cajidiocan, Romblon, Under Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred and Thirteen, to Cantagda of the Same Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2866_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Priority 31, for the Province of Romblon, under School Building Schedules, Appendix B of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and thirteen, is amended to read as follows:
"31 Cajidiocan Cantagda Construction of one room prefabricated. 2,600.00
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
